description: The preliminary expectation of one uniquely discoverable 39-record run was false: the structural scan found 40 valid consecutive records and two possible 39-record windows.
deciding_experiment: Hash the extra predecessor record and each selected record; compare independent stock-executable sector arithmetic with the historical direct-offset implementation.
impact: The selected ID 1 start remains 0xE9B000 because two independent address derivations agree there; signature-only ID labelling is prohibited, and the predecessor's purpose carries forward as unknown.
notes: The predecessor at 0xE99800 is an exact duplicate of selected ID 1, so no byte-content test can distinguish them.
